title: Morgan Stanley’s Amy Oldenburg: The Digital Gold Investment Case for Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Morgan Stanley’s Amy Oldenburg: The Digital Gold Investment Case for Bitcoin Bitcoin's digital gold case is strong, says Morgan Stanley’s Amy Oldenburg, but she wants less tech risk correlation and more gold-like trade behavior. This post Morgan Stanley’s Amy Oldenburg: The Digital Gold Investment Case for Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
